result.instructions: Tools for Smartrr, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscriptions have a failed bill this week?"; "Show every active subscription that renews in the next 7 days."; "Pause the subscription of jane@example.com until January 15.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Smartrr data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartrr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartrr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartrr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smartrr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartrr_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List customer subscriptions (Smartrr 'purchase states') with status, next billing date, selling plan, line items, shipping address, discounts and the customer (id, email, name). Filter by status, next billing date or creation date. The ids you need for the other tools: `id` (subscription id), `custRel.id` (customer id) and `shopifyId` (Shopify subscription id). GET /vendor/purchase-state.

next_billing_after.description: Only subscriptions whose next billing date is on or after this date.

next_billing_before.description: Only subscriptions whose next billing date is on or before this date.

created_after.description: Only subscriptions created on or after this date.

created_before.description: Only subscriptions created on or before this date.

sort.description: Sort by creation date (default: Smartrr's own order).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smartrr_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: One subscription by its Shopify subscription id (the `shopifyId` field from smartrr_list_subscriptions, passed exactly as shown): status, schedule, next billing date, line items, discounts, shipping address, customer and payment method (brand, last digits and expiry only). GET /vendor/purchase-state/{shopifySubscriptionId}.

shopify_subscription_id.description: The subscription's Shopify id (`shopifyId` in smartrr_list_subscriptions).

tools.name: smartrr_list_customer_subscriptions
tools.title: List a customer's subscriptions
tools.description: List the subscriptions of one customer, by Smartrr customer id (`custRel.id` from smartrr_list_subscriptions, or `id` from smartrr_list_customers). GET /vendor/customer/{customerRelationshipId}/purchase-state/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smartrr_get_subscription_events
tools.title: Get subscription history
tools.description: The 250 most recent events on a subscription (pause, skip, cancel, activate, billing attempts and failures, line-item and address changes, discounts) with who did it. GET /vendor/purchase-state/{shopifySubscriptionId}/events.

shopify_subscription_id.description: The subscription's Shopify id (`shopifyId` in smartrr_list_subscriptions).

tools.name: smartrr_get_subscription_orders
tools.title: List a subscription's orders
tools.description: Orders generated by one subscription, by its Shopify subscription id. GET /vendor/purchase-state/{shopifySubscriptionId}/orders.

shopify_subscription_id.description: The subscription's Shopify id (`shopifyId` in smartrr_list_subscriptions).

sort.description: Sort by creation date (default: Smartrr's own order).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smartrr_get_subscription_bills
tools.title: List a subscription's bills
tools.description: Billing attempts of one subscription (amount, status pending/processing/succeeded/failed/canceled, billing date, retry count, error), by its Shopify subscription id. GET /vendor/purchase-state/{shopifySubscriptionId}/bills.

shopify_subscription_id.description: The subscription's Shopify id (`shopifyId` in smartrr_list_subscriptions).

sort.description: Sort by creation date (default: Smartrr's own order).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smartrr_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List Smartrr customers (subscribers) with email, name, phone, order count, total spent and custom attributes. Search by email fragment or filter by Shopify customer id. GET /vendor/customer-relationship.

email.description: Customers whose email contains this text.

shopify_customer_id.description: Only the customer with this Shopify customer id.

sort.description: Sort by creation date (default: Smartrr's own order).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smartrr_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders Smartrr has synced from Shopify (subscription and one-time) with totals, status, financial and fulfillment status, tracking, items and customer. Filter by processed date or order label (e.g. #1001). GET /vendor/order.

processed_after.description: Only orders processed on or after this date.

processed_before.description: Only orders processed on or before this date.

order_label.description: Orders whose Shopify order label contains this text, e.g. #1001.

sort.description: Sort by creation date (default: Smartrr's own order).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smartrr_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by its Shopify order id (the `shopifyId` field in smartrr_list_orders, passed as shown). GET /vendor/orders/{shopifyId}.

shopify_order_id.description: The order's Shopify id (`shopifyId` in smartrr_list_orders).

tools.name: smartrr_list_bills
tools.title: List bills
tools.description: List billing attempts across all subscriptions with amount, status (pending, processing, succeeded, failed, canceled), billing date, retry count, error and the subscription and customer. Filter by billing date; `status` filters the returned page only (use page_size 100 and next_page to cover more). Bill ids are numbers. GET /vendor/bill.

status.description: Keep only bills in this status (applied to the fetched page, not server-side).

billing_after.description: Only bills with a billing date on or after this date.

billing_before.description: Only bills with a billing date on or before this date.

sort.description: Sort by creation date (default: Smartrr's own order).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smartrr_get_bill_history
tools.title: Get bill history
tools.description: The audit trail of one bill: every status change, retry and error. GET /vendor/bill/{billId}/history.

tools.name: smartrr_list_selling_plan_groups
tools.title: List subscription programs
tools.description: The store's subscription programs (selling plan groups) and their plans: name, options, delivery and billing frequency, discounts. GET /vendor/selling-plan-group.

tools.name: smartrr_list_cancellation_reasons
tools.title: List cancellation reasons
tools.description: The cancellation reasons configured in Smartrr (id, type, text, action, retention discount). Use an `id` as reason_id when cancelling a subscription. GET /vendor/cancellation-reasons.

tools.name: smartrr_get_analytics
tools.title: Get subscription analytics
tools.description: Active subscription count and active subscriber count for each day in a date range. GET /vendor/analytics-simple.

tools.name: smartrr_pause_subscription
tools.title: Pause a subscription
tools.description: WRITE: pause a customer's subscription until a date: no orders or charges are created while it is paused, then it resumes on that date. Reverse it with smartrr_resume_subscription. Takes the customer id and subscription id from smartrr_list_subscriptions. PUT /vendor/customer/{customerId}/purchase-state/{subscriptionId}/pause.

tools.name: smartrr_resume_subscription
tools.title: Resume a subscription
tools.description: WRITE: reactivate a paused or cancelled subscription; the customer will be billed on next_billing_date and every cycle after. Customer-facing: it restarts charges to the customer's card. PUT /vendor/customer/{customerId}/purchase-state/{subscriptionId}/activate.

next_billing_date.description: The next billing date after reactivation.

tools.name: smartrr_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a customer's subscription
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: cancel a customer's subscription in the merchant's store (this is the customer's Smartrr subscription, not your usefulapi plan). It stops all future orders and charges; the reason may trigger Smartrr's configured cancellation emails or actions. It can be undone only with smartrr_resume_subscription. Get reason_id from smartrr_list_cancellation_reasons. PUT /vendor/customer/{customerId}/purchase-state/{subscriptionId}/cancel.

tools.name: smartrr_skip_order
tools.title: Skip a subscription order
tools.description: WRITE: skip one scheduled order of a subscription (no order and no charge for that cycle; the schedule moves on). `date` is the scheduled order date to skip; omit it to skip the next one. Reverse with smartrr_unskip_order. PUT /vendor/customer/{customerId}/purchase-state/{subscriptionId}/skip.

date.description: The scheduled order date to skip (default: the next order).

tools.name: smartrr_unskip_order
tools.title: Unskip a subscription order
tools.description: WRITE: restore a previously skipped order of a subscription, so it is billed and shipped again. `date` is the skipped order date; omit it to restore the earliest skip. PUT /vendor/customer/{customerId}/purchase-state/{subscriptionId}/unskip.

date.description: The skipped order date to restore (default: the earliest skipped one).

tools.name: smartrr_set_next_billing_date
tools.title: Set next billing date
tools.description: WRITE: change the date on which a subscription is next billed and its order created. Customer-facing: the customer is charged on the new date. PUT /vendor/customer/{customerId}/purchase-state/{subscriptionId}/next-billing-date.

tools.name: smartrr_retry_bill
tools.title: Retry a failed bill
tools.description: WRITE, CHARGES THE CUSTOMER: retry a billing attempt now. If it succeeds the customer's saved payment method is charged for the bill amount and the order is created. Check the bill with smartrr_list_bills first; do not retry a succeeded bill. Not idempotent: each call can charge again. Requires confirm=true. POST /vendor/bill/{billId}/retry.

confirm.description: Must be true: confirms the customer's saved payment method should be charged now.

prompts.title: Get started with Smartrr
